page.title: Run review
page.purpose: Review a completed run as an ordered chapter timeline with its disposition, evidence references, and the resolution rung used at each step.

priorities.statement: The terminal disposition is shown verbatim and never softened.
priorities.notes: Passed, failed, aborted and unavailable are different outcomes; collapsing them destroys the signal.

priorities.statement: Each chapter shows expected versus observed, plus the rung and confidence used to resolve its target.
priorities.notes: This is how a reviewer tells a proven result from an inferred one.

priorities.statement: Captures are presented as redacted references with checksums, never raw bytes.
priorities.notes: Screen frames can contain secrets; redaction status is part of the evidence, not an afterthought.

states.description: One or more chapters failed; the first failing chapter is anchored.
Run could not execute; the missing capability and next action are shown.
Captures exist but redaction is unverified; they are withheld rather than displayed.
